en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large hilltop castle complex with a tall church-like tower rising above a clustered village in a forested valley. The buildings have steep, tiled roofs and Baroque-style architecture. A road curves along the right side of the image. At the top, in red script, is the caption 'Schloss Weesenstein.' Additional small printer's text appears along the left edge. The lower margin is blank and slightly stained, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
